labels.note: Two-char header like "a=" would return {} instead of {a:""}; rare edge input.
Input "=" would yield {"": ""} instead of {}; unrealistic input.
Trailing valueless token like "a=1; foo" produces garbage key via negative slice bounds.
"foo; a=1" would add garbage key "foo; a"; valueless cookie handling breaks.
eqIdx points at '=', endIdx at ';' or len; they can never be equal.
Without backtrack, valueless segment merges into next key producing garbage entries.
"foo;a=;b=1" skips cookie a (empty value) since backtrack lands past the '=;'.
Filter-rejected empty-valued cookie restarts at '=', yielding empty key or infinite loop.
